# CHRONYX

> CHRONYX is a private personal system of record — a quiet space to manage tasks, finances, tax, study plans, documents, AI notes, and memories with full data ownership.

CHRONYX is a single, calm dashboard for everything in personal life: study planning (UPSC, SSC, OPSC, banking), Indian tax calculation (Old vs New Regime), expense and income tracking, EMI and insurance management, AI-assisted notes (NoteFlow), a personal digital library, and a memory vault. Users keep full ownership and can export or delete all data at any time. Built as a Progressive Web App.

## Features

- [Study Planner](/app/study): Templates, syllabus tracking, and timetable for UPSC, SSC, OPSC, banking, and tech exams.
- [FinanceFlow](/app/financeflow): Unified personal finance — expenses, income, accounts, AI Gmail import.
- [TAXYN Tax Calculator](/app/tax): Indian Income Tax engine, Old vs New Regime comparison, deductions, PDF reports.
- [NoteFlow](/app/noteflowlm): AI-powered notes with images, slides, and explainers (Gemini-powered).
- [Knowledge Hub Library](/app/library): Read PDF and EPUB books; share knowledge and earn rewards.
- [News (NEWSTACK)](/app/news): Curated India and world news feed inside the dashboard.
